scope: 1949-08-14/15/17/18/20 one-year governance corpus; ordinary-governance breadth expansion
method_note: Treat retrospective newspaper/government-official achievement narratives as contemporaneous evidence of claims and administrative priorities, not as self-validating proof of outcomes. Quantitative claims remain open for independent official-statistics verification.

documents.title: 건국 1년의 업적(무역편)：金益均
documents.author_attribution: 金益均; article identifies author as Korea International Trade Association vice-chairman
documents.source_class: contemporaneous newspaper text in official historical database
claims: 1948 private trade totals were reported as exports 5,969,748,097 won and imports 8,759,772,324 won, roughly fivefold the prior year's total trade by the author's comparison.
Government-trade exports after government establishment, Sep 1948-Jul 1949, were reported as USD 5,108,489 plus HKD 488,629.

The author describes a 1949 shift from relatively free trade toward planned trade through import restraint and quotas, while explicitly identifying weak domestic capital, foreign-merchant dominance, lack of trade finance, inflation and world demand weakness as unresolved constraints.
The article is unusually useful adversarially because its author praises policy change but also records structural failures and caveats rather than presenting a pure success narrative.
open_verification: Cross-check figures against Ministry of Commerce/Finance/customs series; separate private, government and aid trade; verify Kim Ik-gyun identity and office timeline.

documents.title: 독립 1주년 우리가 쌓은 자취：교통편
documents.source_class: contemporaneous newspaper text in official historical database
claims: Document HOI and transport-sector one-year retrospective were directly opened; detailed transport statistics remain queued for extraction and independent comparison.
open_verification: Extract rail/road/transport restoration figures and compare with Ministry of Transportation statistics.

documents.title: 독립 1주년 우리가 쌓은 자취：군경편
documents.source_class: contemporaneous newspaper text in official historical database
claims: The article frames army and police as paired national-security institutions and attributes anti-guerrilla and 38th-parallel duties to joint military-police activity.
It separately describes naval fishery-line/patrol and anti-smuggling activity, and women's police work in child protection, job placement and family disputes.

The text itself ends with a qualification that military and police still required further democratic development; this is retained as contemporaneous internal criticism rather than omitted from the achievement narrative.
open_verification: Adversarially compare policing claims with National Assembly records, rights-abuse investigations and later official findings; do not infer presidential direct command from this article.

documents.title: 독립 1주년 우리가 쌓은 자취：방직편
documents.source_class: contemporaneous newspaper text in official historical database
claims: The article reports 1948 textile output value as 17.64 billion won, 37.8% of the referenced production total, and total cloth output as 46,145,320 yards across listed categories.
It reports 1,329 textile factories at end-1948 and cites a plan to expand spinning capacity from about 300,000 to 500,000 spindles over five years.

It identifies the May 1948 northern electricity cutoff, insufficient southern power, raw-material supply and market/speculation problems as constraints, so the output figures should not be read as uncomplicated policy success.
open_verification: Cross-check Commerce Ministry industrial census, power allocation and Agriculture Ministry cotton-plan units; article contains a likely unit/scale issue in cotton figures requiring adversarial verification.

documents.title: 독립 1주년 우리가 쌓은 자취：採炭篇
documents.source_class: contemporaneous newspaper text in official historical database
claims: The article reports 1948 coal production of 641,072 tons, comprising 573,067 tons anthracite and 68,005 tons bituminous coal.
For seven state mines it reports Jan-Jun 1949 production totaling 492,410 tons, while still recording July reliance on imported coal for transport, power and civilian allocations.
The coexistence of increased domestic output and continued imported-coal dependence is retained as a mixed-result claim rather than a success-only interpretation.
open_verification: Cross-check Commerce Ministry mine statistics and later Korea Coal Corporation institutional chronology; reconcile article's June total discrepancy in prose versus monthly table.

documents.title: 독립 1주년 우리가 쌓은 자취：체신편
documents.source_class: contemporaneous newspaper text in official historical database
claims: The article reports international wireless telegraph/telephone service from 1948-12-01 and transfer of former U.S.-used shortwave coastal facilities in June 1949.
It lists new or improved trunk circuits and local telegraph/telephone service points, and reports Korea-U.S. parcel post beginning 1949-07-01.
It records postal reorganization and insurance-limit changes while also noting public complaints about failed telephone connections and mail delivery, preserving service-quality counterevidence.
open_verification: Compare with Ministry of Communications annual report and law establishing local communications offices; verify each route/service opening date.

documents.title: 정부수립 1년 간 업적：공보처장 李哲源
documents.source_class: contemporaneous senior-government-official retrospective in newspaper, preserved in official historical database
claims: The author dates the Korea-U.S. administrative-transfer agreement to 1948-09-11 and cites the 1948-12-12 UN General Assembly vote as 48-6, followed by recognition by 17 states in his one-year retrospective.

The article attributes defense organization, fiscal balancing, tax/monopoly/customs measures, currency-absorption policy, import prioritization, industrial plans, power rationing, coal development and land reform to government policy, but these are executive self-descriptions requiring document-by-document verification.
It reports average available generating capacity around 85,000 kW against minimum demand of 130,000 kW and describes priority allocation to defense, security and transport.
Because this is a government spokesperson's retrospective, it is registered primarily as evidence of official claims and priorities, not neutral outcome measurement.
open_verification: Resolve 李哲源/李鍾淵 identity and role timeline; map each policy claim to statute, gazette, budget and ministry record; compare with opposition/National Assembly assessments.

documents.title: 반민족행위특별조사위원회, 재일 반민자와 국회 내 반민자 소환에 노력 중
documents.source_class: contemporaneous newspaper report in official historical database
claims: The report identifies committee chair Lee In as publicly urging surrender and reports more than 30 central surrenders by Aug 13.

It records efforts via the Korean representative in Japan concerning Park Chun-geum, Lee Gi-dong, Lee Hae-san and Lee Gap-nyeong, plus investigation of public officials and Defense Ministry personnel.

It names National Assembly members Lee Jong-rin, Jin Heon-sik, Lee Hang-bal, Han Eom-hoe and Shin Seong-gyun as persons reportedly summoned, with Lee Jong-rin reported as appearing first on Aug 14. These are procedural/reporting claims, not findings of guilt.
open_verification: Cross-link summons to surviving committee case files; distinguish suspicion, summons, indictment and judgment; verify name readings/identities.

documents.title: 裵重赫 국회의원, 국가보안법 위반혐의로 목포에서 형사에게 체포
documents.source_class: contemporaneous newspaper report in official historical database
claims: The report identifies Bae Jung-hyeok as a National Assembly member from Bonghwa, North Gyeongsang, arrested at Mokpo pier by Mokpo Police Station special-investigation officers while returning from a Jeju inspection.

It reports that the arrest was requested by the Seoul Metropolitan Police Bureau and was said to concern a National Security Act violation; it does not establish the exact statutory count, warrant basis, indictment or later judgment.
open_verification: Trace warrant, charging instrument, prosecution and judgment; build Bae's constituency/party/committee role timeline separately from the arrest event.

adversarial_flags: Achievement-series figures are contemporaneous claims, not verified outcome statistics.
Trade article itself records foreign-merchant dominance, finance scarcity and policy weaknesses.
Textile article records severe electricity/raw-material constraints and requires unit checking.
Coal article records import dependence despite output growth and contains an internal June-number inconsistency.
Communications article records public service complaints alongside expansion claims.
Military-police article contains laudatory framing but also an explicit call for further democratization.
Anti-collaboration summons and security-law arrest are procedural events and must never be transformed into guilt findings without later adjudicative evidence.
